Kanye West’s collaboration with Louis Vuitton marked a turning point in the relationship between hip-hop and luxury fashion. Released in 2009, the collection introduced the Don, Jasper, and Mr. Hudson sneakers, blending Kanye’s creative direction with Louis Vuitton’s craftsmanship and helping redefine what artist-led collaborations could achieve.

At a time when luxury fashion kept its distance from hip-hop, Kanye challenged that divide. His work with Louis Vuitton demonstrated that musicians could contribute meaningfully to high fashion, opening doors for a new generation of creatives. The collaboration became a cultural milestone, influencing not only sneaker design but the broader fashion industry.
